configure_mask_rcnn_vitdet_for_lvis: configure a Mask R-CNN model with PEv1 ViT backbone for LVIS instance segmentation training
set_pev1_backbone_config: set the PEv1_det backbone with 50 layers, 1536 embed dim, and window attention for ViTDet
configure_fed_loss_predictor: configure the box predictor to use federated loss with sigmoid CE for 1203 LVIS classes
setup_lvis_dataloader: setup the LVIS v1 train and val dataloaders with RepeatFactorTrainingSampler for long-tail category balancing
configure_lr_schedule: configure a WarmupParamScheduler with MultiStepParamScheduler for 75 epoch training on LVIS
